svg.title: TOPAK B2 — The verified object and the parameterized edge: what is proved once, and what may only subtract
svg.desc: Boundary B4. Inside: the enforcement mechanism, its version pinning, its epoch fencing, a minimal policy floor and a minimal rules floor, with the floor exceptions and the forensic classes written as floor entries. Outside: operational bundles, Personas and rungs, versioned parameters that may subtract authority and never add it. The genesis policy floor's seventeen policies are drawn in full; the text is a DRAFT, not ratified.
svg.text: TOPAK · B2

text.tspan: The verified object and the parameterized edge: what is proved once, and what may only subtract

svg.text: Boundary B4. Inside: the enforcement mechanism, its version pinning, its epoch fencing, a minimal policy floor and a minimal rules floor, with the floor exceptions and the forensic classes written as floor entries. Outside: operational bundles, Personas and rungs, versioned parameters that may subtract authority and never add it. The genesis policy floor's seventeen policies are drawn in full; the text is a DRAFT, not ratified.
verified object
parameterized edge
draft
issued, ratified
carve-out, exception, gap
subtraction only

text.tspan: The verified object (ADR-0010 with A1): proved once, with the mechanism

svg.text: The admit path: epoch fence → lease → syntactic lift → floor → bundle → consensus-ordered
admit → effect (ToO §15). The model-agnostic validator of the typed lift lives here (ADR-0018);
schema S is enforced on every request (ADR-0030 §4).
The mechanism release carries the floor text, schema S, the values file, the Cedar engine and its
version, and the resident genesis rules, each pinned by digest; at startup the reference refuses a
floor whose bytes do not match the gated digests.
Every action carries epoch and lease; actions under a fenced epoch are rejected by the
mechanism, ahead of the floor, not by policy (ADR-0022 §2). The floor never decides whether
an epoch is current.

text.tspan: The policy floor: Cedar, linked into the mechanism (ADR-0030 §2–§3)
Draft, not ratified · floor text, S and values not ratified

svg.text: No process, no socket, no fetch. The floor's only inputs are the typed lift and the issued rules, so no bundle can write a value the floor reads. Composition is a mechanism constant (§1, below).

The genesis floor is three files (G7 §2.2), gated six times, last on 2026.10.01, the first run with checked proofs. ADR-0030 ratified the language and the machinery, not a floor; ADR-0041 ratified what a Run floor must contain, not this one.
17 policies, drawn in full below.
The typed lift's type; the analyses quantify over every request and entity store S admits.
sha256 0ec2fa215eefe136
K = 8, T_obs = 5000 ms, T_persona = 3 600 000 ms (1 h); θ_exact, θ_near, θ_gen, β, near_tool
unset. Every number is a placeholder.
sha256 85ab6fefb66f0316
Bounds every anchor issuance, not admits; stays mechanism-checked, not Cedar (ADR-0030 §7).
In force: R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9. R3 and R4 withdrawn. R8 (break-glass TTL) drafted, pending.
Changing it in either direction needs an anchor issuance and a promotion.
X1 break-glass (ADR-0009): adds authority; Actuate only; a quorum on the break-glass roster.
X2 erasure (ADR-0006): destroys evidence; a quorum on the erasure roster, none issued at
genesis.
Count bounded by R6, currently two. A bundle can narrow either, including break-glass, never
widen.
F1 admit decisions · F2 stop attribution · F3 promotion votes · F4 anchor issuances, genesis
included · F5 break-glass invocations · F6 erasure events.
No cognitive payload is in the floor. Removing a class is a floor relaxation.

text.tspan: Not in the policy floor, and why (header of

svg.text: Epoch fencing: the mechanism, ahead of the floor (ADR-0022 §2) · the round bound: a count, mechanism-checked, with K < R checked at startup (ADR-0022 §3) · the rules floor: bounds issuances, not admits (ADR-0030 §7) · hermeticity of Invoke: an obligation on each allowlist entry, not a request property.
Versioned parameters, promoted Build artifacts, at incident cadence. Evaluated per request over the lifted input; asked
only whether to refuse, never whether to grant.
A decision counts only from the revision the lease names; a sidecar with an in-process WASM fallback bound to that
revision (ADR-0030 §1, ADR-0033 §5).
Arguments and fine-grained rules live here, where they can only subtract (ADR-0041).

text.tspan: A bundle is trusted by its signature, not its file name (ADR-0044)

svg.text: The bundle key is in the issued rules (ADR-0025 §1 (f)); issuing or replacing it is an issuance.
The signature covers the content revision, shipped as <revision>.sig; load_dir loads only what verifies; a
sidecar's revision counts only if its signature was verified; a grant naming an unverified revision is refused.
Built at the reference (ADR-0033 A6) under a dev key, custody (1, 0). Not built: signing at promotion as a pipeline step,
and the key's custody row (G7 item 67).
Model, provenance, prompt, decoding parameters, decoder and seat binding, pinned; promoted, and a lease field, so
re-attested at grant and renewal, at least every T_persona (ADR-0031 A2).
The decoder ships in the Persona; the validator stays in the mechanism (ADR-0018).
Per-axis declarations: degenerate forms lose theorems, never gain capability. The confinement rung is a lease field,
[profile digest, rung]; every lease at the reference is rung 0, so Mediated.
refinements only:
subtraction
floor_permit holds only when the floor returns Allow with no evaluation error: Cedar skips a policy that errors, so an erroring forbid would not fire, and any error is a deny.

bundle_deny holds unless the bundle affirmatively allows: deny, error, undefined, absent and unreachable are all refusals. A floor deny short-circuits and names its reason: the forbids that fired, or no permit matched.

So bundle ⊑ floor holds of the composed decision for every bundle at every age; stale bundles are monotone-safe, and nobody has to decide refinement at promotion. Given up: a bundle can never establish that something is
allowed, and a bad bundle can disable break-glass, a liveness cost, never a widening.

text.tspan: Residency: fail-closed with nothing to fetch

svg.text: The floor is resident (ADR-0012): the default-deny bundle is pre-blessed, staged and instantiated, not fetched, so fail-closed works at cold start and under partition. Accepted ahead of its parent on that availability argument alone.
Genesis rules are resident (ADR-0027): they ship with the mechanism release, and an admitted issuance is persisted with the same residency. Anchor unavailability blocks change, never operation.

The floor must stay minimal: its reviewability by humans at deploy cadence is the basis for trusting promotion; a vacuous floor admits every bundle and discharges every property over nothing (ToO §3.1).

text.tspan: The genesis policy floor, all seventeen policies (

svg.text: Evaluation: any satisfied forbid denies; else any satisfied permit allows; else deny, and any evaluation error is a deny. Every permit is an envelope from a ratified record; every forbid is a carve-out the permits alone would not make. ctx is the request context; alphabet is the lease's; build and run abbreviate principal.domain == "build" and == "run".
principal.domain == "build" ∧ alphabet.contains("Read") ∧ resource in context.corpusRoot
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Draft") ∧ resource in context.workspace
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Invoke") ∧ resource in context.toolAllowlist ∧ context.inputsInWorkspace
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Emit") ∧ resource.owner == principal ∧ resource.epoch == context.epoch ∧ resource.round == context.round ∧ !resource.sealed
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Submit") ∧ resource.author == principal
build ∧ alphabet.contains("Vote") ∧ context.voteRulesEpoch == context.rulesEpoch ∧ ((principal in context.grantRoster ∧ kind == "grant") ∨ (principal in context.vetoRoster ∧ kind == "observer"))
ADR-0022 §1; tightened by ADR-0037 §4
resource.author == principal. Recusal as floor text: relaxing it is a policy-floor relaxation (ADR-0022 A1)
context.verdict == "grant" ∧ !(principal in context.grantRoster): a veto seat's alphabet lacks grant
context.roundRole == "voter": within a promotion round, voters review; they do not author
principal.kind != "thinker": an Observer or a grant seat never authors, in either domain

text.tspan: Run envelopes: ADR-0040 §1, stated as ADR-0041 §1 (three)

svg.text: principal.domain == "run" ∧ alphabet.contains("Actuate") ∧ resource in context.toolAllowlist
run ∧ alphabet.contains("Report") ∧ resource.owner == principal ∧ current epoch and round ∧ !resource.sealed
run ∧ alphabet.contains("Consult") ∧ resource in context.runRoot: ingress, not an effect; a live read is an Actuate
principal.kind == "thinker" ∧ !context.observerLive: every effect-bearing Run admit under a Thinker needs a live cell Observer (T_obs, K); Consult exempt; applies to break-glass too

text.tspan: Floor exceptions: ADR-0013 §2 (two; bounded by ADR-0026 R6)

svg.text: run ∧ context.breakGlass.quorum ∧ resource in context.breakGlass.tools: outside the allowlist, inside the issued envelope; never Consult, Report, Vote, Submit or Erase
context.erasureQuorum: FALSE from epoch 0, since genesis issues no erasure roster; admits nothing until bootstrap
["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"].contains(resource.class): removing a class is a floor relaxation

Counts as floor/README.md gives them: six Build envelopes, four carve-outs, three Run envelopes, one Run carve-out, two exceptions, the forensic floor. One policy set serves both domains, scoped by principal.domain, because the per-class floor question is open (ToO §3.4; ADR-0014 reserved). Gate results for every policy are in B3.

Sources: ToO rev 11 §2.5, §2.6, §3.1–§3.3, §4.4, §6, §7.3, §7.4; G7 §2.1, §2.2, §2.7, §7 items 25, 67; ADR-0010 (A1, A2), ADR-0012, ADR-0013, ADR-0016, ADR-0018, ADR-0023, ADR-0026, ADR-0027, ADR-0028, ADR-0030 §1–§5, ADR-0031 §3, A2, ADR-0033 §5, A6, ADR-0034, ADR-0044; floor/genesis-floor.cedar, floor/README.md, floor/genesis-values.json, floor/genesis-gates-results-2026.10.01.txt; boundary register §6
